feature: Fire skill-suggest on every non-glue beforeSubmitPrompt, not just sessionStart
problem: skill-suggest.py fires only inside harness-context.sh (sessionStart hook). For mid-session prompts, harness-gate.sh (beforeSubmitPrompt) exits {} immediately in Case 1 (harness active) without ever consulting skill-suggest.py. Users typing prompts like 'review my code' or 'audit the architecture' mid-session get no skill routing hint.
proposed_solution: 1) Remove the early exit in Case 1 of harness-gate.sh; instead set harness_active=true and continue. 2) Add Case 5 (skill-suggest) after Case 4: for any non-glue, non-opt-out prompt, run skill-suggest.py and if matches exist return them in followup_message. 3) Guard with SKILLS_DIR env var (default: .cursor/skills, fallback: $SCRIPT_DIR/../skills) for testability. 4) Sync change to both library/cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh and .cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh.
acceptance_criteria: STRENGTHENED: Run hook from a tmp dir with a state.json present (harness active) + SKILLS_DIR=<absolute path to repo>/library/cursor/skills, prompt 'review my code' → output JSON has followup_message containing 'SKILL SUGGESTIONS' AND output != '{}' (mid-session skill routing works; skill-suggest fires even when harness is active; silent pass-through is wrong)

STRENGTHENED: Run hook from a tmp dir WITHOUT state.json (cold start) + SKILLS_DIR=<absolute path to repo>/library/cursor/skills, prompt 'review my code' → output JSON followup_message contains 'SKILL SUGGESTIONS' AND does NOT contain 'HARNESS ROUTING' (simple pattern falls through to skill-suggest, not planner routing; both paths must not fire simultaneously)

ACCEPTED: Run hook from tmp dir with state.json + SKILLS_DIR=<absolute path to repo>/library/cursor/skills, glue prompt 'ok' → output is exactly '{}' (glue filter still suppresses suggestions even when skills dir is present and harness is active)

ACCEPTED: Run hook from tmp dir WITHOUT state.json, prompt 'migra o banco' (no SKILLS_DIR set) → followup_message contains 'HARNESS ROUTING' and does NOT contain 'SKILL SUGGESTIONS' (cold-start routing exits before reaching Case 5; harness routing gates skill-suggest)

STRENGTHENED: Run hook from tmp dir with state.json + SKILLS_DIR=<absolute path to repo>/library/cursor/skills, prompt 'translate this to french' → output is exactly '{}' (no skill trigger matches this domain-neutral prompt; previous prompt 'what does this do' was fragile because future skills could add generic triggers like 'what')
ACCEPTED: diff library/cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh .cursor/hooks/harness-gate.sh exits 0 (files byte-for-byte identical)
edge_cases: STRENGTHENED: SKILLS_DIR unset AND no .cursor/skills in CWD → hook exits exactly '{}', returncode == 0, and stderr contains no Python traceback (graceful fallback; previously only output was checked, not clean subprocess exit)
ACCEPTED: pytest tests/eval/test_harness_gate.py -q exits 0 — all 14 existing assertions still pass after the refactor (no regressions on glue, routing, harness-active, simple-pattern cases)

NEW: SKILLS_DIR set to an existing but empty directory (no SKILL.md files inside) → hook exits exactly '{}' without error (zero-match boundary: empty dir is distinct from missing dir and must not cause skill-suggest to crash or produce output)
